$FDXF Q1 FY27: revenue $2.4B, +8% Y/Y, driven by priority services. Operating margin was 10.4% as costs outpaced sales growth and compressed profitability. #earnings #airlines

$WEC Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $2.3B, +9% Y/Y, driven by warmer-than-normal weather and capital plan execution. Operating margin 24.6%; net earnings $390M. Guides 2026 EPS to $5.60–$5.64. #earnings #utilities
$AGCO Q3 2026: revenue $2.3B, -9% Y/Y, driven by lower sales volumes in Europe, Middle East, and Latin America. Operating margin 5.1%. #earnings #industrials
$VMC Q3 2026: revenue $2.2B, -5% Y/Y, as concrete declined while aggregates formed the largest share. Operating margin 24.0%. #earnings #mining
$RIVN Q3 2026: revenue $2.2B, +38% Y/Y, driven by new electric vehicles. Gross margin 8.2%; operating margin -40.9% and net earnings -$907M as operating costs exceeded revenue. #earnings #autos
$SIRI Q3 2026: revenue $2.2B, -0% Y/Y, as subscriber revenue remained the primary sales driver. Operating margin 22.2%. #earnings #media
$IR Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $2.1B, +6% Y/Y, driven by organic growth across industrial and precision segments. Operating margin 37.9%; operating cash flow $648M. #earnings #industrials
$KBR Q3 FY27: revenue $2.0B, +5% Y/Y, as growth in STS technology sales and engineering offset reductions in MTS space programs. Operating margin 9.2%. #earnings #industrials
